sentences.text:
(Shivam Dwivedi Vs The State Of Madhya Prade
 Dated : 04-12-2025
Shri Sachin Shukla- Advocate for the appellant.
Shri S.K. Shrivastava- Public Prosecutor for respondent
Heard on I.A.No.18617/2025, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant- Shivam Dwivedi.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 18.07.2025 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO Act), Rewa (M.P.) in SC No.34/2024, whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced under Section 5/6 of POCSO Act r/w Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-
and Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act and life imprisonment with fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulations.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant is innocent.
It is further submitted that though DNA report is positive but victim has herself admitted so also her mother has corroborated the age of the victim was major at the time of incident.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Shri S.K. Shrivastava, learned counsel for State opposed the prayer for suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without 2 CRA-7503-2025 commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant- Shivam Dwivedi and release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties in the like Shivam Dwivedi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172520499/
1 amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court 27.01.2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant- Shivam Dwivedi shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
